items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I played a concert with him in Europe about 3 years ago and he was all love and kisses and whatnot.

ctx.x: Do you see Miles at all these days?

No, but I like Miles. When I began praying Miles called me Reverend Williams and I gave him prayers and I sent him a lot of things. I played a concert with him in Europe about 3 years ago and he was all love and kisses and whatnot. I think he's very fond of me. I don't know what happened; I really don't know if all these things are as bad as some people say, but I think he became discouraged. I wasn't there but I heard during that period that I used to see him in Birdland, that Miles was abused by a policeman or…
